turn 4 fetched only the threading anchor; the agent then replaced CoreDispatcher use with DispatcherQueue.

turn 36 caught ten unfinished mapping rows; turns 39 and 46 caught the startup crash after the build was clean.

tools_problematic.problem: The installed winapp CLI has no build command, although SKILL.md instructed the agent to use it.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 24: "'build' was not matched" and exit code 1.

tools_problematic.problem: Target discovery only searched bin/<arch>/Debug, so it missed native dotnet build output under bin/Debug.
tools_problematic.evidence: turn 33: status=unavailable, "No build output found under bin\x64\Debug" immediately after turn 32's successful build under bin\Debug.

tool_limitations.limitation: It walked only the project directory and omitted external MSBuild Include+Link items.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Resolve linked Compile/ApplicationDefinition/Page/Content items and materialize supported files at their Link paths before triage.

tool_limitations.limitation: It did not verify local ResourceDictionary Source paths and therefore reached only a generic 0xc000027b smoke-crash diagnostic.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Fail preflight with the referring XAML file and line when a local merged dictionary does not exist.

tool_limitations.limitation: A native stowed exception produced event 1000 but no event 1026 managed stack.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Keep the native-code fallback, but add deterministic preflight checks for common XAML package-path failures.

doc_errors.where: winui-uwp-migration/SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instruction
doc_errors.correct: Use native `dotnet build`; reserve winapp for registering/launching packaged output.

special_apis.special_handling: StoreContext.OfflineLicensesChanged can arrive off the UI thread; marshal UI updates with DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue.
Legacy UWP projects may keep App.xaml, code-behind, shared styles, pages, and assets outside the project directory; copy the Include file to the logical Link path.
A package-root URI such as /Styles/Styles.xaml must have a file at that exact logical package path; a root Styles.xaml is not equivalent.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The migration skill documented a command absent from the installed winapp CLI.

errors_encountered.error: NETSDK1022 duplicate Page items for Styles.xaml and seven scenario XAML files (turn 25)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent explicitly added Page items to an SDK-style project that already includes XAML pages by default.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the explicit Page Include entries.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103 InitializeComponent/AppTitleBar not found in MainWindow.xaml.cs (turn 27)
errors_encountered.root_cause: MainWindow.xaml used x:Class=Store.MainWindow while its code-behind namespace had been changed to SDKTemplate.
errors_encountered.fix: Make the XAML x:Class and code-behind fully qualified type match.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Implicit System.Net.Http imports collided with explicit Windows.Web.Http imports.
errors_encountered.fix: Fully qualify the intended Windows.Web.Http types or remove the competing using.

errors_encountered.error: WMC1509 warning plus WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 errors for local:Scenario DataTemplate (turn 27)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The recreated DataTemplate used x:Bind/x:DataType that the XAML compiler could not resolve in the migrated namespace/project shape.
errors_encountered.fix: Preserve the source's classic Binding DataTemplate instead of introducing x:Bind during migration.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Copied UWP declarations were compiled with nullable reference types enabled by the new scaffold.
errors_encountered.fix: Use nullable fields where initialization is deferred and initialize required properties/static references explicitly.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable despite a successful build (turn 33)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The helper did not search the default bin/Debug layout.
errors_encountered.fix: Search both platform-qualified and native dotnet output roots.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent built before completing the migration mapping statuses.
errors_encountered.fix: Flip each completed row to done or deferred, then rerun validation.

errors_encountered.error: dotnet run exit -1073741189; validator startup crash 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll (turns 35, 39, 43, 46)
errors_encountered.root_cause: App.xaml referenced /Styles/Styles.xaml, but the agent copied the linked style dictionary to root Styles.xaml; the local package URI was unresolved. This is the concrete XAML path defect left in the final tree and matches a native XAML activation failure.
errors_encountered.fix: Materialize the linked file at Styles/Styles.xaml or update ResourceDictionary Source to the actual package-relative path; validate every local dictionary URI before launch.

dev_agent_struggles.where: turns 5-23, shared shell and content reconstruction
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent manually opened and recreated App/MainPage/styles/seven pages and copied assets after bootstrap reported only ten files.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately 18 turns before the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap ignored external Include+Link items in Store.csproj.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Most shared files were manually copied, but Styles.xaml was placed at the wrong logical path.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Materialize external linked items at their Link paths in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: One nonexistent build command and two failing dotnet builds preceded a clean build.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Three build attempts after winapp build failed.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Wrong build guidance plus manual project/XAML reconstruction errors.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Switched to dotnet build; removed duplicate Page items; fixed namespace, binding, ambiguity, and nullable issues.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Native dotnet build guidance and linked-file bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The helper reported no build output, forcing the agent to fall back to dotnet run.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The helper assumed bin/x64/Debug while dotnet emitted bin/Debug.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent bypassed the helper; the underlying startup problem remained.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Search both output layouts in Test-AppLaunch.ps1.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Four launch attempts and three validator runs repeatedly produced 0xc000027b; removing MicaBackdrop did not help.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Four launch attempts; three validator runs.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No managed event 1026 was available and the validator did not identify the broken local style dictionary URI.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the trial; the agent correctly reported incomplete.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A deterministic ResourceDictionary Source existence check.
